summary: Puma home shirt: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge on the front, Stingray on the upper chest, Elkem on both shoulders, altibox patch on the left sleeve, LNS on the right sleeve, The Quartz Corp on the back; Novo Nordisk on the shorts and Coop Nordland on the socks. SpareBank 1 is a foundation-held savings bank, Stingray and Novo Nordisk sit under the Novo Nordisk Foundation, Elkem is majority-owned by China's Sinochem (proposed concern), Altibox sits in the municipality-owned Lyse group, LNS is family-owned, The Quartz Corp is Imerys/Norsk Mineral, Coop Nordland is a cooperative.
